source_conservation.frameworks: Exact current cached source membership and existing historic edges are retained as source lineage, not blanket current-version compliance equivalence.

testing.transport: Actual kubernetes.client.ApiClient and bounded GET pool -> fake urllib3 HTTPResponse at asserted TLS host/path/method/query -> real collect -> public evaluate_snapshot; no CASES used as provider data.
testing.hard_blocks: Socket connections/sendto, DNS helpers and ambient Kubernetes credential loaders forbidden. Inert explicit SDK auth exists only in the fake configured transport.
testing.receipt_history: Six published family receipts are immutable predecessor records. Shared Azure admission caused one import rejection and an interrupted remediation-gate run, explicitly preserved separately; current gate was rerun after root repaired atomic admission. The kubelet-https predecessor proof replays only exact prior LEGACY_MAX via scratch pytest plugin, without reverting files or changing current consumer code.
testing.existing_skip_reason: test_actual_saved_snapshot_replay_if_available: saved native snapshot is not part of the portable source checkout.
testing.source_verification: All174 cached upstream files verified against supplied pinned SHA256;40 supplemental evaluator Python files fetched only from the immutable GitHub revision and hashed separately. No cloud endpoint or credential request was made.

defects_fixed.before: --anonymous-auth false and unrelated --profiling false could manufacture a captured false boolean and permit PASS.
defects_fixed.after: Bare bool never consumes a space value; unsupported positional form is UNKNOWN. Native Go bool aliases normalize safely.

defects_fixed.before: Flags after -- were treated as active declarations.
defects_fixed.after: Explicit terminator is unresolved; no after-terminator token is promoted to a flag.

defects_fixed.before: Underscore aliases could bypass a forbidden flag or contradictory duplicate guard.
defects_fixed.after: Kubernetes underscores normalize to hyphens before duplicate/value checks; etcd aliases are not invented.

defects_fixed.before: Empty/arbitrary/duplicate modes lacked AlwaysAllow and could PASS an exclusion predicate.
defects_fixed.after: Native API-server/kubelet allowed values are validated, malformed declarations are UNKNOWN.

defects_fixed.before: Enabled required plugin simultaneously disabled could PASS.
defects_fixed.after: Invalid overlapping enabled/disabled names are UNKNOWN.

defects_fixed.before: A shell/env wrapper containing an absolute component path could be treated as an ordinary nonapplicable workload.
defects_fixed.after: Basename-recognized wrapped binary is ambiguous and unresolved; no shell parsing or execution.

defects_fixed.before: Unordered membership of true and false duplicates could PASS regardless last value.
defects_fixed.after: Malformed/duplicate feature-gate map keys remain UNKNOWN.

defects_fixed.before: 1.19+ unused compatibility flag or removed flag produced PASS/FAIL instead of nonapplicability.
defects_fixed.after: Effective flag bound<=1.18, missing/prerelease versionsUNKNOWN; modern declaration NOT_APPLICABLE.

explicit_proof_limits: Declarations do not attest the executing image/binary, host filesystem, file contents, effective daemon config, certificate validity, authorization, network reachability, audit delivery or retained events.

The configured credential/origin and supplied cluster_id select the cluster; metadata UID/resourceVersion are retained but absent UID currently falls back to resource name. No independent cloud cluster identity assertion is made.

Nine workload paths and all assigned IDs receive native good/bad/gap tests, including selected namespace rejection. Arbitrary shell wrappers/image entrypoints/env expansions, custom binaries, direct host daemons and invisible managed control-plane settings cannot be reconstructed.

Native producer scans approved whitelisted argv only, max1024 tokens and2048 per retained flag value. SDK/list JSON is received in memory before sanitization; no bounded streaming byte-transfer guarantee is claimed. Explicit call/page/resource limits preserve incomplete coverage.

Existing feature-gate consumer accepts reviewed unqualified true/false map syntax; new prefixed component formats and noncanonical boolean spellings inside map values are conservatively unresolved. General duration syntax outside the reviewed parser remains unresolved.

Static upstream bodies are reviewed, not executed with a live cluster or arbitrary company policy. Current Prowler cipher defaults and substring/default bugs are not silently equated to the existing six-suite native policy.
Shared helper structural/GVK/name corrections belong to the workload owner and are consumed as current source; source/canonical/registry/front-end integration remains coordinator-owned.
